description:
Galaxy workflow example that illustrate the process of setting up a simulation system containing a protein, step by step, using the [BioExcel Building Blocks](/projects/11) library (biobb). The particular example used is the Lysozyme protein (PDB code 1AKI). This workflow returns a resulting protein structure and simulated 3D trajectories.

Designed for running on the https://dev.usegalaxy.es Galaxy instance.
name: Protein MD Setup tutorial using BioExcel Building Blocks (biobb) in Galaxy
tools:
download a protein structure from the pdb database
 biobb_io_pdb_ext

energetically minimize the system - part 1
 biobb_md_grompp_ext

energetically minimize the system - part 2
 biobb_md_mdrun_ext

energetically minimize the system - part 3
 biobb_analysis_gmx_energy_ext

fill the box with water molecules
 biobb_md_solvate_ext

fix the side chains, adding any side chain atoms missing in the original structure
 biobb_model_fix_side_chain_ext

free molecular dynamics simulation - part 1
 biobb_md_grompp_ext

free molecular dynamics simulation - part 2
 biobb_md_mdrun_ext
